description: This file defines the main React component for an interactive flow editor called 'Agentflow'. It includes internal components, hooks, and external library integrations to render and manage a flow diagram with features like node palette, header, and dialog modals.

classes.name: Agentflow
classes.description: A React component that renders an embeddable flow diagram editor with optional header and palette.

classes.description: Internal component managing the flow diagram canvas, state synchronization, and user interactions.
